tagline.en: Wickenburg to the Rockies, over the Colorado at Hoover Dam
tagline.zh: 自威肯堡北抵落基山，越胡佛坝跨科罗拉多河

start.zh: 亚利桑那州威肯堡，与 US 60 相接

end.en: The Canadian border at Roosville, Montana, north of Eureka
end.zh: 蒙大拿州尤里卡以北的鲁斯维尔加拿大边境口岸

en: US 93 is the western interior's north–south spine, and it is the most direct road between Phoenix and Las Vegas. From Wickenburg it crosses the Sonoran Desert to Kingman, climbs through the Joshua trees of the Detrital Valley and crosses the Colorado River just downstream of Hoover Dam, then runs through Las Vegas and turns north-east into the Great Basin: Ely, the long empty valleys of eastern Nevada, and Wells.

North of the Nevada line it becomes a mountain road. It climbs the Snake River plain past Twin Falls, follows the Big Lost and Salmon rivers through Arco, Challis and Salmon, and crosses the Continental Divide at Lost Trail Pass into Montana's Bitterroot Valley. From Missoula north it is the main street of the Flathead country — Polson, Kalispell, Whitefish — and it ends at a small port of entry at Roosville, where British Columbia Highway 93 carries the number on towards Cranbrook. The Federal Highway Administration describes it as a high-priority trade corridor; for much of its length it is still two lanes.
zh: US 93 是西部内陆的南北脊梁，也是菲尼克斯与拉斯维加斯之间最直接的道路。它自威肯堡穿越索诺兰沙漠至金曼，经底特里塔尔谷的约书亚树林上行，在胡佛坝下游不远处跨越科罗拉多河，随后穿过拉斯维加斯，东北折入大盆地：伊利、内华达东部一连串空旷的长谷，以及韦尔斯。

越过内华达州界后，它变成一条山路。它沿斯内克河平原上行，经双子瀑布城，再沿大洛斯特河与萨蒙河穿过阿科、查利斯与萨蒙，在洛斯特雷尔山口跨越大陆分水岭，进入蒙大拿的比特鲁特谷。自米苏拉北上，它就是弗拉特黑德一带各镇的主街——波尔森、卡利斯佩尔、怀特菲什——并终止于鲁斯维尔一处小型口岸，界河对侧由不列颠哥伦比亚 93 号公路把这个号码继续带往克兰布鲁克。联邦公路管理局称其为高优先级的贸易走廊；而它的大部分路段至今仍是双车道。

en: The route's two signature works are both responses to conflict. The first was the Colorado River crossing. For decades US 93 traffic drove over the crest of Hoover Dam on a two-lane road with hairpin approaches; after September 2001 commercial trucks were banned from the dam altogether, forcing them onto a 75-mile detour. Planning for a bypass had begun in the late 1980s, and construction started in 2002. The Mike O'Callaghan–Pat Tillman Memorial Bridge, a twin-rib concrete arch about 890 feet above the river, was dedicated on 14 October 2010 and opened to traffic five days later.

The second is in Montana. When the state proposed widening US 93 across the Flathead Indian Reservation, the Confederated Salish and Kootenai Tribes objected, and the disagreement ran for years until the Federal Highway Administration brought the parties together around the principle that "the road is a visitor" and should defer to the landscape. The memorandum of agreement signed in December 2000 produced a 56-mile reconstruction between Evaro and Polson, known as the People's Way, with 41 fish and wildlife crossing structures — 40 underpasses and one overpass — plus wildlife fencing, jump-outs and cattle crossings. Defenders of Wildlife describes it as having more crossing structures than any other continuous stretch of highway in North America.
zh: 这条路线上两项标志性工程都是冲突的产物。第一项是科罗拉多河的跨越。数十年间，US 93 的车流都要沿一条带发卡弯引道的双车道公路开过胡佛坝坝顶；2001 年 9 月之后，商用卡车被彻底禁止通行大坝，只能改走一条 75 英里的绕道。绕行线的规划始于 1980 年代后期，2002 年开工。迈克·奥卡拉汉—帕特·蒂尔曼纪念大桥是一座双肋混凝土拱桥，桥面高出河面约 890 英尺，2010 年 10 月 14 日举行落成典礼，五天后通车。

第二项在蒙大拿。当该州提出把穿越弗拉特黑德印第安保留地的 US 93 拓宽时，萨利什与库特奈联合部族提出反对，争议持续多年，直到联邦公路管理局把各方召集在一起，确立「道路是客人」、应当顺应这片土地的原则。2000 年 12 月签署的协议备忘录催生了埃瓦罗至波尔森之间 56 英里的重建工程，即所谓「人民之路」，其中包括 41 处鱼类与野生动物穿越构筑物——40 处下穿、1 处上跨——以及野生动物围栏、逃生坡与牲畜通道。野生动物保卫者协会称，其穿越构筑物数量多于北美任何一段连续公路。

en: US 93 was not in the 1925 draft; it entered the system when AASHO adopted the numbering by ballot on 11 November 1926. The first official log, printed in 1927, gave it 768 miles, from the Canadian boundary at Gateway, Montana, south through Idaho to a dead end at Wells, Nevada. The northern crossing shifted about five miles east to Roosville around 1934, and Gateway ceased to be a port of entry.

The number then went looking for a southern end. AASHO extended it to Glendale, Nevada, in June 1931; in 1935 it was pushed on through Las Vegas and across the newly finished Boulder Dam, coinciding with US 466 to Kingman, Arizona — a log of that period gives 1,311 miles. In 1965 Arizona got it extended from Kingman to US 89 near Wickenburg, but its request to carry it all the way to Nogales was refused because that would have duplicated US 89. Twenty-seven years later, when Arizona gave up US 89 south of Flagstaff, US 93 finally took over the last 5.95 miles into Wickenburg: AASHTO's Route Numbering Committee deferred the request in October 1991 and approved it on 13 June 1992, fixing the southern terminus where it stands today.
zh: US 93 并不在 1925 年的草案中；它是在 1926 年 11 月 11 日 AASHO 以各州投票方式通过编号方案时进入系统的。1927 年印行的首份官方里程表给它的长度是 768 英里：自蒙大拿州盖特韦的加拿大边界向南穿过爱达荷，止于内华达州韦尔斯的一处尽头。约 1934 年，北端口岸东移约五英里至鲁斯维尔，盖特韦不再作为入境口岸。

此后这个号码一直在寻找它的南端。1931 年 6 月，AASHO 把它延伸至内华达州格伦代尔；1935 年又经拉斯维加斯、越过刚建成的博尔德坝继续南推，与 US 466 共线至亚利桑那州金曼——该时期的一份里程表给出 1,311 英里。1965 年，亚利桑那州获准把它自金曼延伸至威肯堡附近的 US 89，但把它一直拉到诺加莱斯的请求被否决，理由是那样会与 US 89 重复。二十七年后，亚利桑那州放弃弗拉格斯塔夫以南的 US 89，US 93 终于接下进入威肯堡的最后 5.95 英里：AASHTO 编号委员会 1991 年 10 月对该请求暂缓处理，1992 年 6 月 13 日予以批准，南端终点自此固定至今。

value.en: $240 million for a 3.5-mile four-lane bypass, of which $114 million was the bridge contract; Arizona and Nevada together provided about $140 million, largely through bonds, and the Federal Highway Administration about $100 million
value.zh: 2.4 亿美元，建成 3.5 英里的四车道绕行线，其中桥梁合同为 1.14 亿美元；亚利桑那与内华达两州共出资约 1.4 亿美元、主要通过发债筹措，联邦公路管理局出资约 1 亿美元

figures.source: FHWA press release 54-10, 14 October 2010, and FHWA Public Roads, March/April 2011

label.en: Length in the last national log
label.zh: 最近一份全国里程表中的长度

value.en: 1,457 miles in AASHTO's 1989 log, the most recent published — a figure that predates the 5.95-mile extension into Wickenburg approved in 1992
value.zh: 在 AASHTO 1989 年、即最近一次发布的里程表中为 1,457 英里——该数字早于 1992 年批准的、延入威肯堡的 5.95 英里延伸段

figures.source: FHWA highway history, 'U.S. 93: Reaching for the Border', citing the AASHTO route log of 1989

why.en: No such figure exists. The route was numbered over existing state roads in 1926 and extended piecemeal into the 1990s; only individual projects such as the Hoover Dam Bypass have published costs.
why.zh: 没有这样的数据。本路线 1926 年沿已有的州道编号，其后至 1990 年代逐段延伸；只有胡佛坝绕行线等单个项目公布过造价。

why.en: Four state agencies count their own segments, and the range is extreme: an urban freeway in Las Vegas, an empty two-lane for a hundred miles at a stretch in eastern Nevada. No combined figure is published.
why.zh: 4 个州的机构各自统计本州路段，且差异极大：在拉斯维加斯是城市高速路，在内华达东部则可能连续上百英里都是空旷的双车道。并无合并数字发布。

label.en: Wildlife use of the Montana crossings
label.zh: 蒙大拿段野生动物对穿越构筑物的使用

value.en: Monitoring of eleven underpasses between May 2008 and December 2009 recorded roughly 3,000 deer, 1,500 coyote, 300 bobcat, 200 raccoon and 200 black bear crossings, with mountain lion, elk, grizzly bear, moose and river otter also using the structures
value.zh: 2008 年 5 月至 2009 年 12 月对 11 处下穿构筑物的监测记录到约 3,000 次鹿、1,500 次郊狼、300 次短尾猫、200 次浣熊与 200 次黑熊的穿越，另有美洲狮、马鹿、灰熊、驼鹿与水獭也使用了这些构筑物

trafficFigures.source: Montana Department of Transportation and Confederated Salish and Kootenai Tribes monitoring, reported in the Intermountain Journal of Sciences

why.en: Condition data are reported to the Federal Highway Administration by state and functional class rather than by U.S. Route number, so no route-level rating exists for US 93.
why.zh: 路况数据按州与功能等级、而非按美国国道编号上报联邦公路管理局，因此不存在针对 US 93 的全线评级。

timeline.en: US 93 is adopted with the numbering plan on 11 November, running 768 miles from Gateway, Montana, to Wells, Nevada.
timeline.zh: 11 月 11 日随编号方案获得通过，自蒙大拿州盖特韦至内华达州韦尔斯，长 768 英里。

timeline.en: AASHO extends the southern end to Glendale, Nevada.
timeline.zh: AASHO 把南端延伸至内华达州格伦代尔。

timeline.en: The route is extended over the new Boulder Dam and along US 466 to Kingman, Arizona.
timeline.zh: 本路线经新建成的博尔德坝、沿 US 466 延伸至亚利桑那州金曼。

timeline.en: Arizona extends US 93 from Kingman to US 89 near Wickenburg; a proposed extension to Nogales is refused.
timeline.zh: 亚利桑那把 US 93 自金曼延伸至威肯堡附近的 US 89；拟延伸至诺加莱斯的方案被否决。

timeline.en: AASHTO approves the final 5.95-mile extension to US 60 in Wickenburg, the present southern terminus.
timeline.zh: AASHTO 批准最后 5.95 英里延伸至威肯堡的 US 60，即现在的南端终点。

timeline.en: A memorandum of agreement among the Salish and Kootenai tribes, Montana and FHWA sets the terms for the People's Way reconstruction.
timeline.zh: 萨利什与库特奈部族、蒙大拿州与联邦公路管理局签署协议备忘录，确定「人民之路」重建工程的条件。

timeline.en: The Mike O'Callaghan–Pat Tillman Memorial Bridge opens, taking US 93 off the crest of Hoover Dam.
timeline.zh: 迈克·奥卡拉汉—帕特·蒂尔曼纪念大桥通车，US 93 自此不再经胡佛坝坝顶。
